slides.en: Extra: one night in Naha, three stops

slides.body: Steak House Chaco Okinawa, Matsuyama, Naha. Open since 1973; steaks are grilled over charcoal. Lunch 12:00–14:00 (LO 13:30), dinner 17:00–21:30 (LO 21:00), Tue–Sat and holidays. Closed Sun and Mon. 32 seats. Cards, IC and QR pay OK. (Gurunavi, Nov 17)

slides.jp:
リブと、
ロブスター。
slides.en: Rib steak and lobster. Yu: seriously good
slides.body: Yu had the rib steak (Japanese beef) and a lobster. On the menu, rib steak runs from 8 oz (200 g) ¥8,250 to 14 oz (350 g) ¥11,880, tax included, with soup, salad, bread or rice, and coffee, tea or ice cream.

slides.en: A wall of awamori and shochu
slides.body: Takayama Ryukyu Bettei, a shochu and awamori bar in Matsuyama, Naha (Pair City Bldg 1F). 19:00–04:00. 22 seats; bookings OK; cards OK. Smoking is allowed at all seats. Yu's otoshi (table snack) was umeboshi. (Tabelog, Nov 17)

slides.en: Live jazz to end the night
slides.body: Jazz Bar Swing Okinawa, Wakasa, Naha. An authentic jazz bar where the owner plays piano live, with band nights on a regular basis (official site). Yu: the best. Hours are not listed online; check their Instagram, @algos.jazzbarswing.
